title_sq: Te Garden Residence Turdiu, Shitet Dyqan Ideal Per Investim!!
description_sq: Tek Ish Fusha e Aviacionit, Shitet Dyqan me hapesire te bollshme. Njesia lokalizohet ne Residencen Turdiu, nje ndertim i ri dhe cilesor me punime bashkekohore ku vihet re termoizolimi i fasades se ventiluar, vetrata te pajisura me dopio xham termik, izolim akustik, sistemet hidraulike te markes Geberit, instalime per sistem qendror ngrohje - ftohje kondicionim multisplit, tre ashensore te nje nder markave me te njohura ne treg. Dyqani ka siprfaqe 111.21 m2 brutto dhe 100.2 m2 netto dhe eshte i organizuar ne nje ambient openspace me 2 tualete . Dyqani ka fasade xhami e cila mundeson reklamimin e biznesit tuaj. Ambienti eshte ideal per restorant, lokal, pastrim kimik, furre buke pasticeri, supermarket, farmaci, laborator analizash (duke qene se shume prane eshte Siptali ushtarak), berber, parukeri, kopesht privat, exchange etj.
title_en: At Garden Residence Turdiu, ideal store for investment!!
description_en: At the former aviation field, a shop with ample space is for sale. The unit is located in Turdiu Residence, a new and quality building with contemporary works where thermal insulation of the ventilated facade, windows equipped with double thermal glass, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit air conditioning system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market can be noticed. The store has an area of ​​111.21 m2 gross and 100.2 m2 net and is organized in an open space environment with 2 toilets. The store has a glass facade which allows you to advertise your business. The environment is ideal for a restaurant, bar, dry cleaning, bakery, pastry shop, supermarket, pharmacy, analysis laboratory (as Siptali is very close), barber, hairdresser, private garden, exchange, etc.
